summary.text: 水 means “water” and developed from a picture of flowing water according to Dong Chinese and Wiktionary. The same character also appears in a compressed form, 氵, at the side of other characters. Recognizing that connection makes the three-dot water component easier to understand.

history.text: Descriptions range from a river to water flowing in several lines. Those formulations share a water image, without requiring every modern stroke to represent a riverbank. Wiktionary also identifies 氺 as another variant and explains 氵 as a compressed, stylized form.
